crm_notes: Account: large regional investment firm exploring RAG for compliance + internal knowledge search.
Key ask: embeddings + reranking for 50M - 200M document index; cost-per-query must be predictable (< $0.03/query target at scale).
Latency targets: top-k retrieval + reranking end-to-end <= 250ms p50, <= 700ms p95 for typical queries. Reranking (cross-encoder) ideally sub-300ms for top-50 candidates.
Desired DBs: currently evaluating Pinecone (managed) and pgvector (self-hosted), asked about Weaviate and Elastic as fallback. Wants connector proofs for all four.

Connector requirements called out in technical deep-dive: bulk ingest (S3 -> connector) 1M docs/hour, realtime upserts with eventual consistency, metadata filtering (boolean + numeric ranges), namespacing per BU, support for cosine & dot-product, hybrid search (BM25 + ANN) hooks.

Scaling concern: index shard strategy + storage cost for 100M embeddings (768-d/1536-d). Interested in quantization/8-bit/4-bit guidance from Redwood Optimize and integrated caching to reduce calls to model for repeated queries.
Security/compliance: must have KMS integration for keys, audit logs for query access (retention 7 years), SSO via SAML, region-specific residency for EU client data subsets.

Routing: want policy for routing to cheaper embeddings model for low-value queries and fallback to higher-quality model for critical workflows. Interested in automated model-variant fallback when Dedicated capacity constrained.
Quote from CTO (paraphrase): 'We need predictable unit economics and a connector that can ingest our history quickly — don't want to spend months plumbing multiple APIs.'

POC plan: ingest 5M doc subset (legal + portfolio reports) via S3 -> Redwood connector, run embeddings with both hosted encoders and self-hosted encoders, evaluate top-k recall and reranker improvement, measure cost and latencies over 2 weeks.
Ask of Redwood: provide connector spec, example bulk ingest job, sample cost modelling for 50M doc index at 1k QPS mixed workload, SLA for p95 latency with Dedicated + caching config suggestions.

Action items from last call: SE to produce connector latency matrix and bulk ingest throughput report; AE to schedule security review handoff; client to identify compliance reviewer (target week of 2026-03-03).
technical_requirements_summary: Indexing scale: target 50M-200M documents, typical embedding dims 1024-1536; storage + retrieval cost breakdown needed.
Throughput: steady-state search 400-1,000 QPS, spikes to 5k QPS. Bulk ingest 1M+ docs/hr for initial migration.
Latency: retrieval + rerank p95 <= 700ms desired; p50 <= 250ms. Reranking expected to run on top-100 candidates for best quality.
Reranking approach: prefer Redwood-hosted cross-encoder option for consistency but must support plug-in external reranker (self-hosted) for sensitive workloads.

Vector DB connectors: must support Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector (Postgres), Elastic. Required: namespacing, metadata filters, hybrid search, bulk upsert API, realtime upserts, server-side similarity scoring options.
Monitoring & Ops: per-query cost breakdown, token-level cost for generation steps, tracing across retrieval->rerank->generate, ingestion job visibility, backpressure signals when index rebuilding.
Compliance: region-specific residency for subsets, audit logs export, retention controls configurable per-namespace, KMS/HSM key rotation support.

poC_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Bulk ingest 5M-doc subset from S3 into test namespace (pgvector + Pinecone connectors). Measure ingest throughput, storage, and index build times.
Phase 2 (1 week): Run embeddings with two encoders (fast cheaper encoder + higher-quality encoder). Measure embedding compute cost and latency.
Phase 3 (2 weeks): Retrieval + rerank experiments: top-50 retrieval -> cross-encoder rerank. Record p50/p95 latencies and quality lift metrics (MRR, recall@k).
Phase 4 (1 week): Cost projection and ops runbook: show cost per query at 100k/day, 1M/day, 10M/day, propose Dedicated sizing or private deployment options.
